description: The generic first obstruction is now certified exactly, but exceptional rank-drop and resonant divisors, the later F4 compatibility check, higher ramification, and fixed-component boundaries remain open.

members.statement: Assuming the Program 2 structural inputs, in the coprime binary-pencil locus with ramification divisor of degree three, the type-(2,5) and generic type-(3,4) Hilbert--Burch branches are automorphic or enter previously excluded cube, fourth-power, fixed-component, or source-shear boundaries; any remaining generic normal deformation lies on the explicit F4 weighted-inflection family.
members.title: Triple Binary Ramification Reduces to an Explicit Weighted-Inflection Family

members.statement: After solving D6=0 over Q(tau)[d]/(q4(d,tau)), prove uniformly that lower binary terms cannot cancel the D5 obstruction on the explicit F4 weighted-inflection family, and then classify the remaining ramification-degree-at-least-four and fixed-component boundary cases.
members.title: Can the F4 Compatibility Check Close Coprime Binary Quartic Pencils?
